## LLM003 Container-injected ChatClient

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | error |
| Framework | Spring AI |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://pgy763.github.io/llm-dev-pitfalls/java/注入ChatClient找不到Bean |
| Turn it off | `LLM003: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM003` on the command line |

Spring AI auto-configuration registers only ChatClient.Builder and ChatModel; there is no ChatClient bean. Injecting it fails at startup, and the error only says "no bean found".

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM003` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm003 -->

## What it looks like

`@Autowired private ChatClient chatClient;` — `ChatClient` has no bean, only `ChatClient.Builder` does.

## How to fix

Inject `ChatClient.Builder` and call `build()` in the constructor, or declare your own `@Bean ChatClient`.
